final: WITH type_avgs AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) as avg_price FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY production_type_code), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) as overall FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL), first_filter AS (SELECT ta.production_type_code, ta.avg_price FROM type_avgs ta, overall_avg oa WHERE ta.avg_price > oa.overall), mean_kept AS (SELECT AVG(avg_price) as mean_val FROM first_filter), second_filter AS (SELECT ff.production_type_code, ff.avg_price FROM first_filter ff, mean_kept mk WHERE ff.avg_price > mk.mean_val), overall_avg2 AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) as overall FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(sf.avg_price) as avg_type_price, AVG(sf.avg_price - oa.overall) as avg_above_overall, AVG(sf.avg_price - mk.mean_val) as avg_above_mean_kept FROM second_filter sf, overall_avg2 oa, mean_kept mk
